recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring a central green 3D infinity-style loop with arrows, set against a deep red background, framed by sharp, futuristic typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy logo balancing a bottom horizontal text bar
Diagonal movement of the central loop contrasting with horizontal text
Complementary color scheme of muted green against saturated red
Layered depth created through drop shadows and 3D extrusion
coreInvariants: Muted sage green for central graphic elements
Sharp, angular geometry in the primary logo mark
Black drop shadows for all floating elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, tilted green loop occupies the center; a wide angular logo sits at the top; a horizontal text bar anchors the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top angular logo mark with its wide horizontal span.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top logo, follow the diagonal loop downward, and rest on the bottom horizontal text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant red negative space around the central loop to emphasize its depth.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted sage green for the central graphic and logo outlines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for logo fill and text outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with lower-value, desaturated green elements to create a grounded, industrial feel.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the bottom text
Interlocking or overlapping strokes for the top logo
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top logo features a central 'T' that acts as a structural pillar for flanking letters
Letters in the top logo are integrated into a single winged shape

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a black footer bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, custom-shaped logo mark paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: 3D extruded infinity loop with directional arrows

preserve: Sharp angularity of the top logo
Wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square geometric feel of the bottom text.
The top logo requires specific geometric interlocking that standard fonts cannot replicate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid deep crimson red background. In the center, place a large, tilted 3D loop in sage green. The loop should have two arrows pointing in opposite directions along its path. Add a black horizontal bar at the very bottom. Apply hard black drop shadows to the loop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: At the top, add a custom winged logo mark in white with a black outline and drop shadow. Inside the bottom black bar, typeset uppercase text in an extended geometric sans-serif with a thin white outline.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent deep red?
Does the central loop have a 3D effect with shadows?
Is the top logo wider than it is tall with sharp points?
Is the bottom text placed inside a black bar?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific letter combinations in the logo
Unique arrow placement on the loop
Exact proportions of the winged logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green loop is desaturated and matte.
Confirm the top logo has a clear black outline.
Check that the bottom text is perfectly centered in the black bar.
Verify the drop shadows are consistent in direction.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Red + Sage Green + Extended Geometric Type + 3D Central Iconography
